name: akinator-client
description: A modern, fully typed Node.js client for Akinator with session persistence, proxy support, retries and 16 languages.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.test:exports: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/esm/index.js').then(m => { if (!m.AkinatorClient) process.exit(1); console.log('ESM entry point loaded successfully') })" && node -e "const m=require('./dist/cjs/index.js'); if (!m.AkinatorClient) process.exit(1); console.log('CommonJS entry point loaded successfully')"
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:exports

author: Lucas7X7
